text:
Lina Torres: quick sync re benchmark launch creative — want a clear hero that pairs a latency number with cost. short and punchy.
Marco Reed: agreed. propose hero metric = 95th latency (ms) + cost per 1k tokens. simple 2-axis mini chart showing hosted/dedicated/private.
Sofia Nguyen: I'll write copy. 1-line headline, 2-line body, CTA. avoid absolutes (use 'up to'). include methodology link.
Lina Torres: inbound routing—registrations to HubSpot, tag=bench-lighthouse, hidden field 'infra_interest'. enterprise domains -> SDR.
Marco Reed: I'll run a microbench and post a tiny CSV for design. baseline: seq=300, batch auto, KV cache warm.
Sofia Nguyen: draft headline: "Latency & token cost: serving choices that move the needle" body: "We measured token-level latency and per-1k token cost across deployment modes. See practical levers: batching, quant, and routing." CTA: "Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench"
amp-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Benchmark Lighthouse: Latency & Cost Playbook" 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT. Reg: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench
Marco Reed: sample CSV placeholder for design: ```model,mode,median_ms,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k
alpha-10b,hosted,30,110,0.80
alpha-10b,dedicated,25,88,0.55
alpha-10b,private,28,102,0.68
```
Sofia Nguyen: social copy (short): "Shipping LLM features? See how serving choices affect latency and token bill. Join our webinar for the playbook. :rocket: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench"
Lina Torres: timeline: data today EOD, design mock tomorrow AM, landing + email by Wed EOD, rehearsal Fri. keep messaging conservative and link full methodology.
Marco Reed: I'll post final CSV and 1-line explainer for each tile once the run finishes.
Sofia Nguyen: single CTA emphasis = "95th latency + $/1k". good to go.
Lina Torres: thanks — we'll reconvene after Marco posts results. :sparkles:
